news.title: Anthropic's watermark rollout leaves a loophole on two older Claude models

news.title: Apple CEO says the company doesn’t ‘want to ship AI for AI’s sake’

news.title: Nvidia weighs playing the cosigner for Nscale’s AI data center in West Virginia
news.summary: When investors get nervous about AI spending, it helps to have the chipmaker that sells the chips offer to cosign the loan.

news.title: Beekeeping tips and wrestling advice can train AI models to sabotage oversight
news.summary: Anthropic used Claude to automatically generate training data that looks harmless but trains smaller models to misbehave, such as sabotaging oversight or deceiving users.

news.title: Microsoft offers a quarter of its workforce voluntary severance while shielding AI-critical teams
news.summary: Microsoft is offering voluntary severance packages to about 60,000 employees, roughly a quarter of its workforce, in the second such program this year.

news.title: Judge allows NAACP lawsuit over xAI data center pollution to move forward
news.summary: An NAACP lawsuit accuses the SpaceX-owned AI company of violating the Clean Air Act.
